title: The Mexican-hat potential
caption: V = −μ²φ² + λφ⁴, drawn in units of λv⁴ against φ/v (so μ² = λv²): a hump at φ = 0 and minima at |φ| = v/√2 = 0.707 v, where V = −¼ λv⁴. The vacuum sits in one minimum, which breaks the symmetry.
alt: A W-shaped curve: a hump at zero field and two equal minima at plus and minus 0.71 v, each at depth minus one quarter.
description: The field takes one of the two minima: spontaneous symmetry breaking.

checks.name: minimum at φ = v/√2 with depth −¼
